title: DbDataBuild command output (--format json)
description: The one JSON document a command writes to standard output with `--format json`. `data` holds what the command found or did, and its shape is checked per command below (`$defs.data_<command>`): keys are present when the command got far enough to produce them (a command refused early has few or none), and null values are omitted rather than written as null. `diagnostics` are the structured form of what text mode prints on standard error; `messages` and `errors` keep the human text so nothing is lost. Exit codes are the same as in text mode: 0 ok, 1 findings, 2 usage, 3 not implemented, 70 internal error. Metadata documents (`validate`, `metadata`) are defined in metadata.schema.json (id urn:dbdatabuild:schemas:metadata).

data_render.description: print: files (with their text under --content) and operations; --write: files, wrote, removed; --check: files, out_of_date.

rows.description: The first violating rows (--limit), each an object of the rule's columns.

against_connection.description: The connection of the right-hand table when it is not the left one's; the comparison is then by digests computed in each engine.

partial.description: Across connections only: so many rows differ that the comparison stopped at the buckets of the key. The counts above are then not known; this says how many buckets differ, how many rows they hold and which columns differ.

samples.description: Present only with --show-values: real values, in the output the operator asked for.

additionalProperties.description: A side that is NULL is left out.

data_review.description: no plan: plans; a plan file: path, intact, plan, report, risky, destructive, apply_needs (a plan that does not parse: path and intact false).
